gen-orbitron-fs-hoover: Precise and minimal, Orbitron spreads its letters far along the line, each eye of the e left wide and clear. Orbitron sets the tone; Hoover, a text serif, does the sturdy reading.
gen-orbitron-gf-courier-prime: Orbitron stretches its letters wide, minimal and precise, with open apertures. Courier Prime, a monospace, fills most of the height with lowercase and draws with the steady line of a technical drafting pen.
gen-orbitron-instrument-sans: Sleek and spaced out, Orbitron stretches wide across the line while Instrument Sans keeps every stroke at a constant weight. Their shared strength is a clean, minimal step from capitals down to lowercase.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-alumni-sans: Retro cut-out letters, pinned far apart and full of fun. Press Start 2P does the loud, playful showing off, while Alumni Sans, with its wide-open c, keeps ascenders barely above the x-height.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-headland-one: Playful retro fun up top, a dignified serif below. Their strongest shared habit is generous spacing: Press Start 2P pins letters far apart and Headland One never risks a touch.
gen-righteous-fs-familjen-grotesk: Commanding and fun, Righteous fills the line with bowls drawn like thin steel rod bent into every letter. Familjen Grotesk reads lively over many lines, its tall lowercase leaving bowls unfinished on one side.
gen-righteous-fs-trench-slab: Righteous fills the line with bowls whose rims match the stems. Trench Slab, a serif with hardly any step from lowercase to capitals, gives that commanding heading a refined, dignified floor.
gen-righteous-gf-savate: Righteous bends thin steel rod into round letters that fill the line, with no swelling or thinning. Savate, a sans-serif, adds hairlines of reasonable sturdiness and open jaws on its curves.
gen-righteous-poppins: Loud, playful letters bent from thin steel rod. Righteous fills the line with bowls, while Poppins settles beneath with rope-loose curves, no thick-thin flicker, and a tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-special-elite-fs-hoover: Hoover reads refined yet robust, its e opening generously and its ascenders cut short beneath distressed Special Elite. A page of it would feel steady, sturdy and never fussy at all.
